item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your thoughts shape how the day feels, so check them before they run the show. When a negative pattern shows up, pause and ask whether you're projecting or assuming what others think. Then choose a response that supports the life you're building. Perspective is a choice you can make again each hour. Action: at midday, stop for one slow breath and name the thought you're choosing next.
